label: preparing
what: Likely joint preparation of a bread-stocked gathering in the great hall, possibly a surprise associated with the Day 1 18:00 lighting inspection. Innkeeper funded freight, who repeatedly baked bread; innkeeper, builder and freight deposited it in the same hall-area container, and builder installed lanterns. Baker supplied additional bread through builder and innkeeper, but knowledge of any concealed purpose is not established. The mayor was explicitly told of the lighting inspection; the record does not establish that the food gathering or a surprise purpose was disclosed, nor does it prove deliberate secrecy. No clear evidence establishes secretary or neighbour as knowing participants in an undisclosed preparation.
